title: "Practical resources"

These 53 checklists, decision aids and templates are linked to the decisions and pause points where they can help.

Use a checklist before starting a study, analysing data or submitting your work. Each one helps you catch omissions while there's still time to fix them.

## Templates

Open **Templates** in the book contents to find meeting agendas, search logs, research plans, data records and writing tools. You can copy them into whatever system you already use.

Priority templates include a completed example alongside the blank version. Adapt the fields to your project.

The public repository keeps the row-by-row status in [`planning/requirements-checklist.csv`](https://github.com/hareshsuppiah/handbook-for-the-recently-enrolled/blob/main/planning/requirements-checklist.csv).
